headword: {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}

definitions.gloss: earnestly honest; wholeheartedly sincere; single-mindedly upright
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is thoroughly honest and sincere in everything they do, without any pretense or calculation. Combines the ideas of honesty and wholehearted devotion.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is an earnestly honest person.

examples.japanese: {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な{性格|せいかく}で、{嘘|うそ}がつけない。
examples.english: With an earnestly honest personality, he can't tell lies.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}に{生|い}きてきた{人|ひと}で、{地域|ちいき}から{信頼|しんらい}されていた。
examples.english: My grandfather lived a wholeheartedly sincere life and was trusted by the community.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) combining {正直|しょうじき} (honest; upright) and {一途|いちず} (wholehearted; single-minded). Used as a na-adjective to describe someone whose sincerity is absolute and unwavering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な{人柄|ひとがら}: earnestly honest character
- {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}に{生|い}きる: to live wholeheartedly and honestly
- {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な{姿勢|しせい}: an earnestly sincere attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実直|じっちょく}: honest and straightforward — similar meaning but a single word
- {誠実|せいじつ}: sincere; faithful — more common, slightly broader
- {一途|いちず}: wholehearted; single-minded — one component, without the honesty emphasis
- {愚直|ぐちょく}: stubbornly honest — implies honesty to a fault
